propositions: _build_jira_backend constructs an AcliClient without validating that required credentials (JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, JIRA_API_TOKEN) are present, allowing silent backend construction that fails later at the first API call

Cloud adapter lacks construction-time credential guards that exist in the DC adapter (JIRA_PAT validation), creating a test-parity gap where unconfigured Cloud environments build a doomed backend without raising an error

JIRA_USER must be validated as an email address (containing @ with non-empty local and domain parts) before AcliClient construction, since Cloud authenticates using the Atlassian account email as Basic-auth username and bare handles silently 401

The test test_cloud_build_backend_with_missing_credentials_does_not_fail_loudly documents the current silent-build behavior but must be flipped to assert that missing credentials raise BackendEnvError at construction time, mirroring DC's behavior
